description: Turn part of this workspace into a pack manifest — the installable form of a schema you just built. Creates nothing; it hands back the manifest. An agent that a rule runs (`run_agent`) is exported with the pack and the rule names it by `$agent:<name>` ref, never by id, so the schedule survives a re-install. [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES export_pack"]

databases.description: Databases to include (name, qualified slug, or id). Omit for the workspace default slice.

space.description: Limit the export to one space.

name: export_pack
title: Export pack
